facts.fact: The General Information Authority's text calls itself a proposal (مقترح) on its cover and title page, dated December 2022; it was prepared with ESCWA, and a national workshop was to discuss its draft (مسودة) with national bodies. It records no adoption.
facts.system: National Strategy for Government Digital Transformation

facts.fact: The proposal text is published on the General Information Authority's website (upload path 2023/03); the document's own date is December 2022.
facts.system: National Strategy for Government Digital Transformation

facts.fact: The vision states that by the end of 2030 everyone in Libya will enjoy world-class government services; the KPI table gives 2022 baselines and 2030 targets.
facts.system: National Strategy for Government Digital Transformation

facts.fact: The proposal sets 2030 targets against 2022 baselines (for example EGDI rank from 162 to 100, 50% on the ESCWA services-maturity index) and lists eleven action areas with initiatives, with no costs or dates for the initiatives; it says a national plan of projects and the budgets are still to be set.
facts.system: National Strategy for Government Digital Transformation

note: The text calls itself a proposal (مقترح) and a draft; it is titled 'Government Digital Transformation Strategy', and its vision is world-class government services, but it is not government services only: its eleven action areas also cover legislation, training, ICT infrastructure, open data, innovation and start-ups, education and research, privacy, and objectives on private-sector investment and a digital society and economy. Class national follows instruments.csv. Its governance (cabinet, supreme oversight committee) and monitoring are proposed, not stated as established, so no governance or reporting fact.
